tianxia.subpath.body.bojutsu.feature.swe.why: combat/ext/bojutsu.py owns Sweeping Strike's optional Staff-hit choice, its single Stamina payment, save and chosen result. Its compile_actions marker exposes manual choices on either side's turn; compiling a generic paid-hit reaction as well would charge again, including after declining the plug-in's choice.

tianxia.subpath.body.black_thorn_demon_b.why: Once per turn on an unarmed-strike hit, spend 1 Demon Spine: add 2d6 Piercing or Slashing (a free player choice), then a Constitution save; on a failure, Bleeding until the start of your next turn (combat/ext/black_thorn_demon_body.py).

tianxia.subpath.body.kensei.feature.blad.why: Once per turn on an unarmed-strike or integrated-Blade-weapon hit, choose one -- Proficiency Bonus Slashing damage, Speed -5, deny Reactions, or draw/stow a Blade weapon (a free player choice, kept until changed) (combat/ext/kensei.py).

tianxia.subpath.body.kensei.feature.seve.why: Once per turn on an unarmed-strike or integrated-Blade-weapon hit, spend 4 Stamina: choose one severing effect (Arm/Leg/Breath/Flow/Guard, a free player choice); the target makes a Constitution save gating its severity (combat/ext/kensei.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.black_current_w.why: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you deal damage with Mind Spike, a Spirit Awakening technique, an unarmed strike, or a proficient weapon attack, move 10 feet without provoking (15 feet, through the target's space, if it is Resonance Marked) (combat/ext/black_current_walker.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci.why: Once on each of your turns when you use Mind Spike, an unarmed strike, or a proficient weapon attack against a Resonance Marked target, add your Wisdom modifier to one damage roll (combat/ext/echo_step_disciple.py). Treating an Echo Position as the attack's origin is a GM-adjudicated positioning rider.

tianxia.subpath.qi.devil_heart_second_fu.why: Once per turn, when you pay at least 1 Qi for a Qi feature, refund Proficiency Bonus Qi, gain 1 Corruption and 1 Devil Qi, then choose one Seed-Fed Reinforcement (Temporary HP = PB; move 5 feet; move Domain Armament 10 feet; or Advantage on an Intimidation/Cultivation Check), a free player choice kept until changed (combat/ext/devil_heart_second_furnace.py).

Once per turn after a qualifying cultivation feature deals damage, offer the owner 1 Devil Qi for 2d8/3d8/4d8 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage and one printed rider; the rider affects only a creature that took the extra damage (combat/ext/devil_heart_second_furnace.py).

tianxia.subpath.qi.black_sea_leviathan_w.why: Once per turn, a Qi-powered feature that damages or forcibly moves a hostile creature places one Depth Mark on it; once per turn, a Qi-powered feature affecting a Depth-Marked creature may spend 1 Inner-Sea Depth to choose one of five riders (a free player choice, kept until changed) (combat/ext/black_sea_leviathan_womb.py).
